lauren: Quick sync 1: propose a compact 'mini-eval' under /optimize that demonstrates SDK -> batching -> prefix/KV cache -> quant-profile decision. Want a single runnable example folks can paste into CI. Thoughts?

mike: I can write a short Python snippet (~15 lines) and push a WIP branch (docs/mini-eval-light). Will include inline comments for each tuning knob.

anjali: Ill run a small perf sweep (seq 32 vs 256) on rw-opt-quant-8b int8/fp16 and paste a tiny table of latency + token-cost.

lauren: Add a 2-line migration note for legacy batch_* keys and link to the migration guide. Keep language minimal.

sam: Found a stale link in /optimize/batching. Ill patch it and add the redirect note in the PR.

jessica: PR checklist: examples/optimize/mini_eval_light.py, examples/tests/test_mini_eval_light.py (mocked smoke), update nav, 2 short recommendations (cache vs batch), and a 1-paragraph fallback guidance for quant regressions.

docs-bot: Created issue #4701 and assigned to @mike and @anjali.

mike: Draft snippet (will include in PR):

from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# prefer int8 for throughput; use fp16 when quality is important
quant_profile = {"preferred_dtype": "int8"}
resp = client.generate(
  model="rw-opt-quant-8b",
  input="Summarize in two bullets:
- long user query
",
  batch_options={"max_batch_latency_ms": 25, "max_batch_size": 6},
  cache={"enable_kv_prefetch": True},
  quant_profile=quant_profile
)
print(resp.text)
